title: OptimVanilla
description: Vanilla, but optimized! (Well that technically makes it not vanilla but it sounds good)
body:
# ![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4a7e07dbd503db68b860bd241ec1849734ace06.png) 

OptimVanilla is a modpack that tweaks the original game using lightweight mods to enhance the gameplay, making it smoother. We all know that minecrafts optimizations is not that great. This modpack aims to improve the optimizations while keeping the simplicity of the original game. 

This modpack is constantly updated to the latest versions and is always changing to maintain that lighweight, optimization. If your looking for a good simple modpack that is easy to use and improves your game, OptimVanilla is great for you. Check below to see all the mods included in this mod pack


<details>
<summary>Notes</summary>

All this modpack does is optimize minecraft. This modpack does not gaurentee the best optimizations and optimizations varies on different computers. If you have any suggestions or ideas for this modpack please DM me on discord at **m0neygreen_**. If you enjoy this modpack dont hesitate to follow to get notifications when I update this modpack. 

_I have based my Configs off of Simply Optimized, You can find them [here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop)_

</details>



<details>
<summary>Mod List</summary>

This Modpack includes 7 mods. 
1. **Sodium** by *jellysquid3*
2. **Lithium** by *jellysquid3*
3. **Iris Shaders** by *coderbot*
4. **ImmediatelyFast** by *Raphimc*
5. **FerriteCore** by *malte0811*
6. **Dynamic FPS** by *juliand665*
7. **Fabric API** b7 *modmuss50*



</details>
